t: What does the Christian fish symbol mean (ixthus / icthus)? | GotQuestions.org
s: November 9, 2004 - In Greek, the phrase is Ίησοῦς Χριστός, Θεοῦ Υἱός, Σωτήρ. When we take the first letter from each word in that phrase, we have ΙΧΘΥΣ, which happens to be the Greek word for “fish” (ixthus or icthus—the spelling can vary in English).
